# Retrieval Beyond Documents (RBD) Workshop

> Capability Retrieval for Language Agents. Workshop at NAACL 2027 in San Francisco, California.

RBD at NAACL 2027 explores capability retrieval for language agents: tools, skills, workflows, memory, models, and agents. Topics, submissions, and speakers.

The workshop day, submission deadlines, and submission portal are to be announced. Author guidelines are a draft; proposed limits and submission arrangements await the final call. Parent conference dates are not workshop dates.
